BillingVerificationError.description: Returned with HTTP 503 when paid access cannot be confirmed right now: the billing provider is re-verifying a recently expired subscription, or the entitlement backend is unreachable. Retryable — honor Retry-After.

code.description: Machine-readable billing-verification state, mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header.

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint, when the denial came from a tier gate.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ForbiddenError.description: Returned when a PRO-gated endpoint denies access because the caller has no resolved authenticated user, entitlements cannot be verified, or the caller lacks the required entitlement tier.

code.description: Machine-readable denial code, present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header).

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint.

GatewayError.description: Returned by gateway infrastructure errors before an RPC handler runs, such as origin, routing, method, authentication, or quota checks.

error.description: Gateway error reason or structured gateway failure details.

caseId.description: Stable identifier of the municipal review case.

caseVersion.description: Exact immutable case version to read.

InvalidRequestBodyError.description: Returned when a JSON POST request body is empty or malformed.

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

OpenLicenseReviewRequest.description:
OpenLicenseReviewRequest creates one active, release-pinned review case.
 Actor, municipality, roles and classification are derived by the server.

items.description: Economic activities registered for the patent.

address.description: Public establishment address associated with the patent.

items.description: Establishment identifiers associated with the patent.
Public display names of associated patent holders.

licenseId.description: Stable municipality-issued source identifier of the patent.

items.description: Machine-readable limitations affecting interpretation of this item.

municipalityCut.description: Municipality code from the authenticated actor's scope.

parcelResolutionStatus.description: Resolution status of the associated parcel.

provisionalStatus.description: Provisional status derived by the upstream normalization pipeline.

reportedStatus.description: Status reported by the source municipality.

RateLimitError.description: Returned when a gateway or handler rate limit rejects the request.

RecordReviewActionRequest.description:
RecordReviewActionRequest appends one human action. action_type is restricted
 server-side because its transition and role rules depend on current case state.

ReviewCaseDossierResponse.description:
The JSON fields contain validated, immutable domain snapshots. Keeping the
 v0.1.0 document intact prevents a lossy transport projection of evidence.

items.description: Actions currently available to the authenticated actor for this case state.

SearchPatentsRequest.description:
SearchPatentsRequest filters the municipal review queue. The municipality is
 intentionally absent: it is derived from the authenticated actor's server-side scope.

address.description: Case-insensitive establishment address text to match.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the preceding page.

effectiveOn.description: Date used to evaluate effective records, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

legalEntityRut.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Non-empty values are rejected because the producer has no queryable RUT.

pageSize.description: Maximum records to return. Zero uses the upstream default; maximum is 100.

releaseId.description: Immutable upstream release to search. Empty allows an explicitly marked last-good fallback.

status.description: Reported or provisional patent status to match.

availability.description: Upstream availability state for this result set.

dataMarking.description: Public-data marking supplied by the upstream dataset.

items.description: Machine-readable limitations applying to the response as a whole.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty means there is no next page.

releaseId.description: Immutable upstream release that produced this response.

UnauthorizedError.description: Returned when the API key is missing, malformed, or lacks current API access.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

ApiKeyHeader.description: Alias header for the WorldMonitor API key (X-WorldMonitor-Key).
ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key

post.description: AssignReviewer records a municipality-scoped reviewer assignment.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key. Retrying a POST with the same key and an identical request body replays the original response (only the status, body, and Content-Type are reproduced) instead of re-executing; reusing the key with a different body is rejected with 422. For mutations this avoids duplicating the side effect, while for batch-read POSTs it replays a cached snapshot that can be up to 24 hours stale. Keys are scoped per authenticated caller (falling back to the source IP for unauthenticated endpoints) and retained for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key echoed from the request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response was replayed from an earlier request with the same key, false on the first (original) request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

400.description: Validation error, invalid Idempotency-Key header, or malformed JSON request body

X-Billing-Verification.description: Present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (value subscription_lapsed, matching the body `code`).

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key supplied by the client.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the in-flight request.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key supplied by the client.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the active rate-limit window resets.

503.description: Service unavailable. Billing-verification responses include code and X-Billing-Verification; other gateway infrastructure failures use the generic GatewayError shape.

X-Billing-Verification.description: Billing-verification state that produced this response (matches the body `code`).

X-RateLimit-Mode.description: Present with value degraded when a fail-closed rate-limit dependency is unavailable.
